_comment: Expected outcomes for the REAL SEBI circulars in regulatory_sources/sebi against the two FICTIONAL tenant corpora. 'expected' is what the deliberately designed policies should produce; the pipeline computes the actual result independently (nothing here is read by production code). UNCERTAIN means the corpus was written to leave the question open.

acme-securities-pvt-ltd-181441765.profile: stock broker + depository participant; no commodity segment; no MF/SIF distribution

nimbus-asset-management-181441765.profile: mutual fund AMC with one SIF strategy; not a broker or DP

cases.why: Addressed to all stock brokers. Acme POL-001 gives clients seven trading days (circular §46.4: not more than five), keeps the policy internal (§46.3: communicate to clients), sends no communication on pledge creation (§46.2), allows exposure on pledged securities (§46.5), and lets Operations extend without limit (§46.12).
Addressed to stock exchanges, depositories and stock brokers; Nimbus is an AMC.

Addressed to mutual funds/AMCs. Nimbus POL-001 §3–§4 mirror the circular: board + trustee approval and website publication (§2.4), permitted purposes (§2.1), quantum limited to receivables (§2.2), same-day repayment (§2.3), scheme-wise records (§2.5), cost borne by the AMC (§2.7).
Addressed to mutual funds, AMCs, trustees and AMFI; Acme is a broker.

Addressed to AMCs, which must ensure distributor compliance (§21.10.5). Nimbus offers a SIF and POL-002 §4.2 requires NISM Series XIII for SIF distribution, whereas the circular requires NISM Series V-D (§21.10.1) and says Series XIII is not applicable after 21 Sep 2026 (§21.10.3).
Addressed to MFs, AMCs, trustees, RTAs and AMFI; Acme does not distribute MF or SIF products.

Addressed to all regulated entities including stock brokers. Acme POL-002 §4 already reports within 6 hours by email and 24 hours on the SEBI portal and files staged updates to closure (circular §2, §4, §5).

Addressed to MFs/AMCs. Nimbus POL-003 §4 says incidents are reported 'in line with the applicable framework' but names no portal, timeline or staged reporting — written to leave the comparison open (NEEDS_INVESTIGATION or CONFLICT are both defensible).
Addressed to MFs/AMCs among others, but the directions are to depositories (§5–§6). Nimbus POL-004 §4.2 commits to connect to the depositories' framework when published.
Addressed to depository participants (Acme is one) but the obligations fall on depositories; Acme POL-005 §3.2/§4.1 adopt depository frameworks. ALIGNED or NEEDS_INVESTIGATION are both defensible.
Addressed to stock exchanges with a commodity derivatives segment; Acme has no commodity segment (POL-003 §2.2).
Commodity derivatives exchanges only; Nimbus is an AMC.
